title: LWCAMPO honors Judge Tijerina for 12 years of service
excerpt: The Laredo & Webb County Area Metropolitan Planning Organization Policy Committee recognized Webb County Judge Tano E. Tijerina for 12 years of distinguished service, including his time as vice chairman and chairman shaping regional transportation planning.
content:
The Laredo & Webb County Area Metropolitan Planning Organization (LWCAMPO) Policy Committee recognized Webb County Judge Tano E. Tijerina for 12 years of distinguished service.

Throughout his tenure serving as both vice chairman and chairman, Judge Tijerina played a vital role in shaping regional transportation planning and infrastructure initiatives across Laredo and Webb County.

Webb County extended its sincere congratulations to Judge Tijerina and thanked him for his longstanding commitment to regional progress.

Source: Webb County, Texas, Facebook, Nov. 18, 2026.
